question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who do you think Brendan should date?

nodes.text: The singing gets louder and louder! The voice turns spooky and ominous!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh my gosh, Brendan... Let's get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm with you!
Brendan and Dinah run out of the room... And a few minutes later, a closet door creaks open!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hello? Is anybody there? Hello?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Phew! I'd hate for someone to hear me practicing my singing!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What the heck was that?! What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I have no idea! I'm just glad we got out of there alive! I was afraid we were going to get sung to death or something!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Do you think that's a good enough story for our article?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What, that we were too scared to stick around the high school music room? No offense, but I'm pretty sure we can do better!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just wish we had another lead...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The other day, Zach went to the music classroom to drop off a homework assignment...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: When suddenly, he heard this music! It sounded like a piano playing with a creepy female voice singing over it!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The freaky thing is, he was all alone in the room!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: He's not the only one... Other people say they've heard it too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: A haunted music room? That's the best you've got?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hey, man. You wanted the scoop, and I gave it to you! What else are you gonna look at? The rumors of a ghost at the arcade?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hmm... I guess I just gave you `two` scoops...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... I guess I just gave you [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] scoops...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Come on, Brendan... Let's go check it out! It couldn't hurt, right?
Brendan and Dinah head down to the music room.
Play as Brendan for a bit, and see if you can solve the mystery!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I still think this is kind of silly... I mean, what kind of ghost hangs out in a high school music room?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You're probably right... That would have to be one lame ghost, wouldn't it?
Suddenly the piano starts playing itself!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No... Way...
And then, from out of nowhere, a hauntingly beautiful female voice starts singing an eerie lullaby!
Dinah jumps forward and grabs Brendan's hand!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Stay calm... Stay calm...
The singing gets louder! The melody is absolutely gorgeous... Sad, lonely, and tragic...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait a minute... I know this song... It's a duet! There's a male part that sings back!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sing it then! Maybe that's what the ghost wants!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay... I'll do my best...
Brendan leans forward and sings beautifully, a booming, powerful bass that resonates throughout the room!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: { Laaa deeee daaaa... Laaaa deeee dooooooo... Sing a love song... Just for youuuuu {

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow, Brendan, that's... That's really good!
The singing grows quieter... Quieter...
Brendan clears his throat and begins singing in an atonal chant...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Dum dum dum... Go away ghost... Dum dum dum... I want toast...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh, Brendan, that's not really singing... You sound kind of like a monk...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, sorry...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Here goes, ghost!
Brendan begins singing... In a high, tinny falsetto!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ghosty, ghosty, leave us alone... Ghosty, ghosty, please go home!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Stop, Brendan! Please stop!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? Why? I thought it was working...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It's not that, it's just... The voice you're singing in... Kind of hurts my ears...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yep! You got it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No, of course not! That's totally wrong! What'd you do, just make a random guess?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I'll admit we're not as well-informed on these things as you are... But that's why we're doing this project! To learn! We want you teach us!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hmm... I `do` like condescendingly explaining things to people...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] like condescendingly explaining things to people...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Okay, okay, you have a deal. You want to know about local ghosts? I did hear one good thing lately.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: That's... Right! Huh, you really do know your stuff!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, you don't get to be a goth without learning how to tell your lycanthropes from your misanthropes!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Touche, Dinah. Touche.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, are you gonna give us the scoop or what?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well, what do you want to know about? Vampires? Monsters? Missing persons? An elaborate conspiracy theory about the nature of the universe?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, actually...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You see, I think that we're all just characters trapped in a cruel virtual world, our fates determined by unseen deities making a series of binary choices...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... That's very interesting, but we're actually looking for any rumors you might have heard about local ghosts.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Well... I did hear one thing recently.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yep! You got it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No, of course not! That's totally wrong! What'd you do, just make a random guess?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I'll admit we're not as well-informed on these things as you are... But that's why we're doing this project! To learn! We want you teach us!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hmm... I `do` like condescendingly explaining things to people...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] like condescendingly explaining things to people...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Okay, okay, you have a deal. You want to know about local ghosts? I did hear one good thing lately.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yep! You got it!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No, of course not! That's totally wrong! What'd you do, just make a random guess?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I'll admit we're not as well-informed on these things as you are... But that's why we're doing this project! To learn! We want you teach us!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hmm... I `do` like condescendingly explaining things to people...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm... I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] like condescendingly explaining things to people...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Okay, okay, you have a deal. You want to know about local ghosts? I did hear one good thing lately.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, sort of... I kind of think it'd be cool to look into some local ghost stories...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's a great idea!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, I do! We can be like those 'Ghost Stalkers' guys on TV... Finding out the truth behind the legends!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I love that show!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, are you doing anything right now? Kat's busy all night, so this would be a good time for me.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'll have to call and check in with her every hour, of course...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um, yeah, I'm free right now.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Great! Where do you want to start?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... I have heard some weird rumors about the Wilson side of town... Something about a creepy figure called 'Mr. Doom'...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, let's not go there. I got stuck on the Wilson side a couple of weeks ago, and I'm still having nightmares.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, I know! That Andrew guy who wrote the school play... He's always talking about all kinds of ghost stories! We should go talk to him!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Sounds good to me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure... Just let me go check in with Kat! This'll only be half an hour... So long as she doesn't want to talk!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: ...Right.
An hour and a half later, Brendan and Dinah head to the library where Andrew is reading a book titled 'UFOs: Fact or Truth?'

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hey, Andrew?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oh, hi, Dinah! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, we're doing this journalism project on local ghosts... And we were wondering if you'd heard any interesting rumors lately!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Maybe I have, maybe I haven't.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: It means, I don't like giving out that kind of info unless I know how it's being used!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You two have quite a rep for doing your little exposes... How do I know you're not really writing an article on what crazy dumb rumors people on campus believe in?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What? No, that's totally not what we're doing! We're both really into the supernatural! Honest!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then what's a wendigo?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... It's a...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awkward? Why would it be awkward?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Well, you know... Because... You know... Us?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm just not following at all.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Does he really have no idea that I like him?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Never mind. It's, um, really exciting. That's what I meant to say!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm glad you agree! So, did you have any ideas in mind?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm... You mean, because of the thing with Kat?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just don't know what her deal is. For some ridiculous reason, she doesn't want me to hang out with you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Wow... Does he really have no idea that I like him?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, I meant it'll be stressful because, uh... I bet Ms. Prez expects a lot from the two of us. We are sort of the star students, you know?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Really? You think so?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, I loved your last article, the expose on corruption in the `Centerscore High Business Leaders Club...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I loved your last article, the expose on corruption in the [color=#3b78e2][i]Centerscore High Business Leaders Club...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Eh, that was okay... Nowhere near as good as your article on the increasingly dangerous and unethical actions of the `Robotics Club.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Eh, that was okay... Nowhere near as good as your article on the increasingly dangerous and unethical actions of the [color=#e23b3b][i]Robotics Club.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, you got any great ideas for what we should do this time?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aw man, I lost! I'm sorry, Sbarrio! Don't hate me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Guess I'll just have to plug in some more quarters...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aw, forget Kat! I see her every night anyway... But right now, I'm having a blast with you!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The truth is... I'm having a great time too! I wonder if he has any idea how I feel about him...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Okay... If you're sure...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I am. And listen to this idea! I say we go investigate... The Wild Woodsman!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The Wild Woodsman? But that ghost story is ancient! Our parents and grandparents know about him! How're we gonna investigate something like that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's start by asking the one person who knows the most about Centerscore history...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Brendan...
Suddenly, the screen turns black! The words 'ACE HERBO' appear in blood-red letters!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's real! The ghost is real!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh my gosh!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Mr. Herbo! Please don't hurt me!
Blue sparks fly out of the joystick! The console buzzes and shakes!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's get out of here!!!
Brendan and Dinah bolt out of the arcade, knocking over several people on their way!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That was ridiculous! Did you see that?! I can't believe it, but Spud was actually telling the truth!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But do you think that's good enough for our article? 'Dead Janitor Haunts Arcade Machine'?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It kind of sounds like something Amanda would write... But listen! While I was playing, I thought of another ghost story we could look into!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you sure? It's getting late... Maybe you should go see Kat...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Woo hoo! I beat the level! Too bad I didn't play a perfect game...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh well. Time for level two!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes! Perfect-a score! I beat-a the level!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, I mean, I did a pretty good job. Ahem, ahem. Time for level two!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well, actually, there is this one thing... It all started two weeks ago...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I was in the corner playing some `Monkey Pong.` I was right about to get a new high score, when suddenly, the machine started acting all crazy!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was in the corner playing some [color=#e23b3b][i]Monkey Pong.[/i][/color] I was right about to get a new high score, when suddenly, the machine started acting all crazy!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: The screen started flashing... The controls stopped working... And little sparks shot out of the joystick and zapped my hands!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: And that's not even the weirdest part! I jumped away, and then the machine just flashed the words 'Ace Herbo'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Ace Herbo?' What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Let me finish my story!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Ace Herbo was a janitor who used to work here! `Monkey Pong` was his favorite game!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ace Herbo was a janitor who used to work here! [color=#e23b3b][i]Monkey Pong[/i][/color] was his favorite game!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: He'd play it every night after he got off his shift... No one could ever beat his high score!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Then one day, he came in and saw that Dexter had managed to top him...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: And he had a heart attack right on the spot!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: He died on the floor of the arcade... And his ghost still haunts that machine!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Come on, Spud. You can't expect me to buy that! A haunted arcade machine?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Believe whatever you want to believe! Go see for yourself... If you think you can get a high score!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm... what do you think, Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: It sounds fishy... But, who knows, maybe there's a great story in it. Do you think you can get that high score?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I can get a high score on `Monkey Pong` in my sleep!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? I can get a high score on [color=#e23b3b][i]Monkey Pong[/i][/color] in my sleep!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Hee hee! I'm gonna go grab a soda from the concession stand. Why don't you give it a shot, and I'll catch up to you in a few minutes?
And so, Brendan settles down at the `Monkey Pong` machine.
nodes.text_bbcode: And so, Brendan settles down at the [b]Monkey Pong[/b] machine.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's see here... I've got to get `Sbarrio the plumber` to the goal... And I've only got three lives...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's see here... I've got to get [color=#e23b3b][i]Sbarrio the plumber[/i][/color] to the goal... And I've only got three lives...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If a barrel comes rolling at me, I've got to jump over it, and if I'm attacked with a fireball, I've got to dodge...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Piece of cake!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha! I told you he wouldn't help us, Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Huh?
Brendan shoots Dinah a big wink.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If he won't help us, then we don't have to do this stupid project! We can just tell Ms. Prez that the subjects weren't cooperative!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Wait, wait, wait... What?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That means I don't have to write any articles tonight! I can just make out with Kat and her sweet, sweet lips... Mmmmm, lips...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Wait! Stop! I'll tell you anything you want to know!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, fine, if you `insist...` Has anything weird been going on around here lately?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, fine, if you [color=#e23b3b][i]insist...[/i][/color] Has anything weird been going on around here lately?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Help us out, Spud!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay... Don't not help us out!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Uh... I won't!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay then, don't not not not not help us out!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I... Will!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Man, you're really good at this, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'm honestly disappointed in you, Brendan. In fact, I'm insulted you'd even try a tactic like that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yeah, Brendan, how could you expect Spud to fall for that? He's `way` too smart and charming!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, Brendan, how could you expect Spud to fall for that? He's [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too smart and charming!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: You... You think I'm charming?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, yeah... And there's nothing that gets me going like a guy with a big ol' brain...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What the heck?! Is this seriously working?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well then, my succulent dark angel, I'd be delighted to answer any questions you have!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Why don't you use that virile, manly memory of yours and tell us if there's been anything weird going on around here lately?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Really? You'd let me do that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course! But hey, we're getting carried away... Let's focus on the assignment.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Right, right... The assignment!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess we can start by asking around, seeing what people can tell us, and...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh oh! Oh crud! Oh crud! Red alert! Nerdcon 5!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Keep your voice down! It's that Spud guy... He's been on my case ever since I started dating Kat! She's his ex-girlfriend or something!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Let's just sneak out of here before he notices...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well, well, well. If isn't my arch-nemesis, Brendan The Barrel-Bellied Brigand.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Spud, I don't even know what that means.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It means, you best get out of here, or I'll pwn you so hard that the only game you'll be playing is 'How Long 'Til The Ambulance Arrives?'

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Wooo, sick burn, Spud! You just gained +2 Intellect!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hey! I thought I told you to stop talking like that when other people are around!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I'm not here to fight you or whatever you were threatening... I just want to get some information for an article.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Pfffft! Fat chance! I'm not telling you anything!
Can you convince Spud? Play as Brendan and find out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All right... I'm gonna have to use every last one of my wits to convince him...

nodes.prompt: I'm gonna have to use every last one of my wits to convince him...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I'm gonna have to use every last one of my wits to convince him...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh yeah? That's awesome!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you play `Warscrewdriver: Online?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Do you play [color=#e23b3b][i]Warscrewdriver: Online?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: War`screwdriver?!` Uh, I mean, yes, yes I do!
nodes.text_bbcode: War[color=#3b78e2][i]screwdriver?![/i][/color] Uh, I mean, yes, yes I do!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Awesome! What race do you play?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... Canadian?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...You're making fun of it, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, no, not at all! It's just that... Well... I don't really play games that much.

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I guess I just said I did because... Um... I wanted you to think I was cooler.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What? That's ridiculous! I think you're awesome, even if you don't play games!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Besides, this just gives me an excuse to invite you over to check out the game sometime!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Which ones are you into?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... I like... 'Shooter Gun... Um... Bang Bang'?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: 'Shooter Gun Bang Bang' is awesome! I love that game! The best part is when you shoot!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... Yes... I also like when... Um... You kill things?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes! That's even better! When the terrorists go down... It's just too awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... Concur.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Man, Dinah, you're so cool... Do you play `Warscrewdriver: Online`?
nodes.text_bbcode: Man, Dinah, you're so cool... Do you play [color=#e23b3b][i]Warscrewdriver: Online[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No, I, um, can't say I do.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You'd love it! You should swing by my house some time and check it out!
Brendan and Dinah head down to the arcade.
Dinah knows the arcade pretty well... Play as her for a bit!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well, here we are!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Do you come here a lot?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, from time to time. I didn't used to, but Linda pointed out that it's a great place to check out g... Games! To check out the latest games!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, it's okay, I guess. I used to come here all the time, but lately, arcades have just gotten kind of lame, you know?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, look at these games! 'Maximum Football '93'? 'Urban Battler 7: Turbo Edition: Omega: Gesundheit'? 'Pastry Chef 2: More Pastries For Some Reason'?!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: All of them are either outdated or lame!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh... Uh... Yeah... That's true... I meant, I come here to look at, um, how `lame` the games are!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... Uh... Yeah... That's true... I meant, I come here to look at, um, how [color=#3b78e2][i]lame[/i][/color] the games are!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Heh... Yeah, totally. So what kind of games are you into?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Uh... I don't know anything about games! I need to think fast!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm really into...
Sbarrio misses his chance!

nodes.speaker: Sbarrio
nodes.text: Why-a would I do that?!
Sbarrio misses his chance!

nodes.speaker: Sbarrio
nodes.text: Why-a would I do that?!
Sbarrio misses his chance!

nodes.speaker: Sbarrio
nodes.text: Why-a would I do that?!
Sbarrio rushes forward!

nodes.speaker: Sbarrio
nodes.text: I'm-a gonna get you!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It all started one hundred and fifty years ago, in the hills not far from here...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: There was a fur trapper who lived out in the woods named Jonah Prez. By all accounts, he was a good, moral man...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: But one day... He just up and lost his marbles!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: For no reason that anyone can understand, he viciously attacked a group of travelling settlers!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Who knows how many people he would have killed if the noble lawman, Obadiah Prince, hadn't shot him down?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: Years after his death, many people reported seeing Jonah's ghost in the woods, calling to them in a spooky voice, drawing them deeper and deeper in...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: It's all nonsense, if you ask me... But it seems people will believe just about anything!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I... I was practicing my singing. You know, using the autopiano.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...Autopiano?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: That was you singing? In the closet?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Well, yeah... I practice in there when no one's around... Not that it's any of your business! What are you doing here, anyway?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, nothing. We were just stopping by. We're, uh, just gonna get going now.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Hey, wait! You, uh, better not tell anyone about this... Or I'll beat you up and drop you on the wrong side of town! Again!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. You want to get out of here, Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Yes, please... Before he starts singing again!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: So how about that? The ghost of the music room turned out to be nothing more than Ryan and an autopiano!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's good, it's good... But I feel like we can scoop an even bigger story than that!
It's time for journalism class, and Ms. Prez has an exciting assignment! Play as Dinah and find out what it is!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Now, as I'm sure you all know, the town of Centerscore has a long and rich history, with dozens of fascinating local legends.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: The Lucky Fountain... The Missing Monument... The Deeply Troubling Wheel of Cheese... I could go on all day!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: For your next project, I'd like you all to investigate some local legends and find out the truth behind them!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I'll do the myth of 'equal work for equal pay' and point out the truth of how women make 75 cents to each dollar that men make!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: ...And before any of you get ahead of yourselves, this time, you'll be working in pairs. Jane, you're with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Girl-time! Sleepovers! Boy-talk! Pillow fights!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Grrrrrr!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Dinah, you'll work with Brendan. I'm sure you two will come up with something great!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I'm with... Brendan?!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well, sure... Is there a problem?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: The problem is that I have a huge crush on him... But he's happily dating Kat!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: No... No, I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: Well, all right then! I look forward to seeing what you two come up with!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Dinah! It's pretty cool that we're partners, huh?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Um... I guess?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What do you mean, you guess? Aren't you excited?

nodes.text: Mamma mia! I'm-a dead! Who's-a gonna take care of my kids?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Rose
nodes.text: You beat-a the level and you didn't-a cost me a life! You are beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Brendan, look!
The screen turns black! The words 'ACE HERBO' appear in a blood-red font!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! Spud wasn't lying!
And suddenly, other letters fade in around them... Forming the phrase 'REPL`ACE` MOT`HERBO`ARD'!
nodes.text_bbcode: And suddenly, other letters fade in around them... Forming the phrase 'REPL[b]ACE[/b] MOT[b]HERBO[/b]ARD'!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, come on! Seriously?!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! That's hilarious!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hilarious? I just wore out my thumbs trying to get that high score!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Oh, you've got to admit it, it's kind of funny... Spud, wetting his bed in terror over a broken motherboard!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ha ha, okay, when you put it like that, it is pretty funny... But I bet we'll need a better story if our article's going to be a hit!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Are you sure? It's getting late... Maybe you should go see Kat...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! I forgot to check in with her on the hour! She must be furious!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh no, oh no... She probably thinks I'm off spending time with another girl!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Well... Technically... You are...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aaaaaaggh! You're right! I've got to go find her right away! The last time I didn't check in, she broke into my house to look for me!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: But... What about our project...?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, who cares about our project?! If Kat dumps me, my life is over! This is a nightmare!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Kat! Kat! I'm coming! Kaaaaaaaaaaaat!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I suppose that's just typical... Fate tries to pair me with my dream guy, and I still find a way to mess it up!
Wow. It takes a certain kind of person to deny a poor girl her destiny... And it looks like you fit the bill!
Give it another shot, and see if this time you can't give Brendan and Dinah a better time!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: After everything we've been through today, you're still afraid of ghosts?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: With our luck, we'll discover it's nothing more than a baby deer and a broken GPS circuit!

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: Ha ha! That's a good point... And I do like baby deer...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean, think of it this way... The last 'ghost' we checked out to be nothing more than a broken arcade machine...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Are we really gonna get scared away by a broken GPS?

nodes.speaker: Dinah
nodes.text: I... I guess not.
Some people say 'practice makes perfect'. If that's true, you must practice a heck of a lot... Because you just played a perfect game!
Enjoy your bonus scene, you practice machine!
Brendan walks back towards his house.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Man... For a minute back there... I really thought Dinah was going to say she liked me or something!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nah, that can't be the case... A girl that smart and funny and cute would never like a guy like me...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh man! I haven't sent Kat a text in hours! She's gonna flip out!
Suddenly, a chill wind blows over Brendan!
Out of a distant mist, a pale eyeless ghoul emerges!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Heh... Heh... Heh...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: What was that?!
Brendan spins around... But nothing is there!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just... Just my mind playing tricks on me... The day made me jumpy...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: There might be ghosts... But that Mr. Doom guy? That's just a dumb story!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Heh... Heh... Heh...
Who is the mysterious Mr. Doom? And what does he want with Brendan?
That's a tale for another episode!
